Figure 1: Overview of the LIMEN framework. The outer loop performs evolutionary search: LIMEN selects a parent interface from the MAP-Elites archive, mutates it via LLM-guided code generation, and evaluates the resulting interface by training an RL agent in the inner loop. The interface (ϕ,R) mediates between the raw simulator state and the agent, defining the observations and rewards that constitute the induced MDP. Fitness is measured by trajectory-level task success and fed back to update the archive.
Figure 3: Evolution progress of LIMEN showing candidate interfaces, crash events, and improvements in the running best success rate across iterations.
